unit: npm install -g pnpm@10 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && pnpm test:coverage --coverage.reporter=cobertura --coverage.reporter=text-summary && cp coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml coverage.xml
regression: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_ci_review*.py' && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_ci_low_risk*.py' && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_ci_resolver_closes_issues.py' && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_ci_held_merge_is_not_a_failure.py' && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_ci_platform*.py' && ( npm install -g pnpm@10 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && pnpm test:perf )
e2e: npm install -g pnpm@10 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && pnpm bundle && pnpm run test:portable && pnpm run test:portable:runtime && bash scripts/release/smoke-mcpb.sh
environment: node scripts/check-health-stdio.mjs "$PWD" && { [ "$CI_OS" = linux ] || { npm install -g pnpm@10 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm bundle && pnpm run test:portable && pnpm run test:portable:runtime && bash scripts/release/smoke-mcpb.sh; }; }
install: claude plugin marketplace add "$PWD" && claude plugin install ai-architect-mcp-spec@ai-architect-mcp-spec-marketplace && root="$(claude plugin list --json | jq -r '.[] | select(.id | startswith("ai-architect-mcp-spec@")) | .installPath')" && test -n "$root" && node scripts/check-health-stdio.mjs "$root"
